decisions.reason: The minimum quantity lubrication line sits close to the core machine-tool customer base and costs little to keep on a modular platform, and the missing website evidence after 2019 leaves its value unresolved, so the option is still worth holding.
The hydrocyclone filter extends the established coolant filtration offer at low carrying cost, and no evidence shows its value has failed, so keeping the option open is justified.
The gravity band filter is a standard, closely related part of the coolant filtration portfolio and is cheap to maintain, and nothing indicates it has failed, so it stays on the market.
